title: flow_summary.spawned is computed by two different formulas on the two golden writer surfaces
evidence: tests/spine_check.cpp:641: `static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live` — PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:137: `ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,` — docs/goldens/SCHEMA.md:45: `| `flow_summary.spawned` | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |`
detail: spine-check emits packets-constructed (matches SCHEMA.md); PPProbe emits Demand.size(), which counts never-fired future demand entries. They equal 11 only because the last entry fires at tick 98 ≤ 100 — the single-sourcing invariant is already violated in code.
recommended_fix: Make both writers use one formula (State.Score + State.Flow.Packets.size(), the schema's 'packets constructed'); Demand.size() silently includes entries with Tick past the run end.

title: A bare same-tick re-step is allowed yet re-runs the flow: double-spawns that tick's demand with no ReplayError latch
detail: The r1 asymmetry fix latches only the with-commands case; the no-commands re-step still re-spawns demand, re-serves edges, redraws the nonce — a silent replay-divergence class the ODN replay-equality contract exists to prevent.
recommended_fix: Return early on Tick == State.Tick regardless of NumCommands (the step_once test only asserts ReplayError==false, which a no-op preserves), or latch both cases.

title: ApplyEdit + StepScenario mixing double-applies a logged draw silently; the live/replay mode split is prose-only
detail: Step cannot distinguish replay input from an already-applied live command. Shipped callers are correct (PPSimDriver.h:40 uses bare `PP::Step(State, State.Tick + 1)`; the r1 test comments 'live: no commands (already applied)'), but the invariant is convention-only.
recommended_fix: Add a structural guard: e.g. an AppliedThrough tick on the state that StepScenario/Step cross-checks, or reject a command whose (apply_tick, payload) was already applied — divergence should latch, not create a legal duplicate pipe.
